hooks.name: Block inline credentials in shell commands
hooks.description: Refuses execute_bash calls carrying a credential inline (rzp_live_, sk-, AIza, ghp_, AKIA, PEM private keys, or SECRET/TOKEN=<long literal>). Prevents the mechanism that leaked four live keys into Kiro's workspace permissions file on 2026-09-19, where "Always allow" recorded the whole command string verbatim.

action.command: D=/Users/wecaredigital/wecare-store; if [ -x "$D/.venv/bin/python" ]; then exec "$D/.venv/bin/python" "$D/scripts/block_inline_secrets.py"; else exec /usr/bin/python3 "$D/scripts/block_inline_secrets.py"; fi
